column1: # espice machine calibration (price plan sec. 4): one value per row, tab-separated.
# model: image Wyhash, then dev_us, host_p_us and host_e_us at 1, 64, 1024 and 16384
# Fixture for placement.tsv (machine.zig, price.zig, context_cost.zig): the constants
# the price carried in code until price plan stage 2 (#126, #139), on the machine
# placement.tsv was measured on: RTX 4060 Laptop (sm_89, PCIe 4.0 x8, 8 GB, FP64 1:64,
# 24 SMs), driver 595.71.05, i9-14900HX (P 0-15, E 16-31). Provenance per row:
# cuInit, the context and module loads in a Problem's first query (#126).
# Launches and the one host wait per eval, the limit pass sharing it (mos1_2000
# phases: 10 us upload and clear, 42 us kernels, 40 us reduce, 19 us download, ~40 us
# of launch and wait around them).
# Staging clear and the two reduce levels (mos1_2000: 4.8 MB in 50 us).
# ParEval on 8 threads against 1: bsim4_2000 3.3x, psp103_2000 1.8x, bsim3_2000 and the
# mos1 decks 1x or slower; 0.1 (1.7x on 8) credits the light models no lanes.
# Walls on a shared machine wander by more than the model's error.
# The probe's host time moves up to 2x between queries under load
# dc/device_hisim2 1328 us against 10 us per eval (130x), ltra_tran_long_run_past_8192
# 39.2 ms against 444 us (88x), cpl_tran_history_past_2048 7.83 ms against 42 us (186x),
# Two waves at 2000 instances give 0.12 of one host thread: mos1 measured 0.093
# (42 us against ~450 us), bsim4va 0.096 (~700 us against ~7.3 ms).
# 444 us over 320 KB (1.36, averaged over its fill); the lower keeps historyLoses short.
# An instance's own fields, a few hundred bytes for a compact model.
# Price plan sec. 0 and 4, 2026-11-03: in-process driver start 135-140 ms; launch+sync
# of an empty kernel 7.6 us (4.8-15); pinned bus 5.6 us, 12.4 / 13.2 GB/s up / down
